task: Write the CIT-E `docs/changes/W2-49-CIT-E.md` for Contract v4.2, and record the owner's approval (DEC-741) in the CIT-P, in one commit (DAEO-ha8z, W2-49).
status: DONE. The commit is `b9e4917e` and the W2-49 suite passes 129 of 129 after it.
work_completed: The pre-flight checks matched what was expected: role `product-spec`, ticket `DAEO-ha8z`, worktree `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-49`, branch `w2/W2-49`, and no `pre-commit` hook (only `*.sample` files). I wrote the CIT-E (state_class EVIDENCE, status APPLIED) in the S2-CIT-E form. It covers:
- what changed, commit by commit: `90c4d20a`, `5a6a12f5`, `7f935156` and this commit, with a table matching each section of CIT-P §6/§7 to what was applied;
- the owner's approval before the change, by CAP-33's route: DEC-741, 2026-10-17, staged. Its first git trace is `1d5449eb`, merged at `1b43c73c`, before `90c4d20a`;
- answers A–K and how each was applied;
- the seven covers items that changed or were added: CAP-43.b, CAP-43.d, CAP-44.f, CAP-44.h, CAP-44.k, CAP-44.l, CAP-45.a, plus the wave notes of CAP-43, CAP-44 and CAP-47;
- the named read (C (i)), with the two files, headings and line ranges, and the ten conditions with their marks: (3) is W2; the other nine are W3, and five of those have a lite part;
- K (1), and K (2) as a reading in its own commit for the owner to confirm or overturn;
- row W2-L343;
- W2-52 (DAEO-siiz) as the ticket that builds the lite A7 and A10 stage records;
- the differences (a)–(f), plus a (g) I found;
- what stays open, the counts (211 → 214: W1 149 / W2 20 / W3 38 / NONE 7), and how the change is reversed.

In the CIT-P I set `status: ACCEPTED`, added an `accepted:` line, changed the `pending:` line, and added §13 "The owner's answers (DEC-741)": one line per answer A–K, with W2-52 named under H. W2-52 appears only in §13. The body is otherwise unchanged; `git diff 0faa0664 HEAD~1 -- docs/changes/` was empty before my edit.

- `docs/contract/` is the same at `a02e3485` (the tests' base) and `1b43c73c` (the diff base).
tests: `PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-49/src python3 -m pytest tests/acceptance/W2-49 -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs` gave 129 passed, run before and after the commit. Nothing was skipped and nothing failed.
discoveries:
- **(g), not in the lead's list:** three wordings in the applied CAP-44.h differ from §6.1's text. "gov doctor green" became "gov doctor green (exit 0)", which is §7 G (i)'s own wording. "each condition not met" became "each lite condition not met". "the auditor accepts no exception" became "only the owner accepts an exception; the auditor accepts none", which is DEC-741 F (i)'s wording. The CIT-E lists this as (g) with those reasons.
- The ticket file says the CIT-P was approved at `0faa0664`. The CIT-E frontmatter records that as `approved_revision`.
- DEC-744 is also missing from this worktree's register, not only DEC-741. The CIT-E lists both as staged or not yet in the register.
- The owner's approval has no `Role: owner` git fact yet. Its only trace here is the orchestrator's `1d5449eb`, and the CIT-E says so plainly.
risks:
- If the owner overturns K (2), reverting `7f935156` drops the eight records, and `test_w2_49_capability_records.py` then has to be dropped too. The CIT-E's §3.3, §8 and §9 describe this.
- The reasons the CIT-E gives for differences (b) and (d) rest on the lead's statement and on the CIT-P giving no placement rule. No register decision states either one.
- The named read (§5) is recorded from the lead's statement. This worker did not read `docs/source/`.
lessons: The CIT-E's covers test compares each covers item's raw fields against the base. So CAP-45.a, which was only reworded, must be named in the CIT-E along with the moved and new items.
proposed_decisions:
- P-1, for the owner: regenerate the record `docs/contract/capabilities/CAP-45.a.md` from v4.2, in its own commit, as an extension of the K (2) reading. It is DERIVED and its item text is stale (difference (f)). Recommendation: regenerate it. Confidence: medium-high.
- P-2: the eight source-map rows (CIT-P §8) are still open. I make no recommendation, since no source settles them.
unresolved:
- The eight `SOURCE_MAP.csv` rows.
- The CAP-45.a record.
- KPI line 3 and the failure line, pending W2-51 (DEC-744); this ticket closes after it.
- W2-I017 is to be carried to Wave 3 at W2-30's close (J (i)).
- The owner's confirmation of K (2).
- DEC-741 and DEC-744 are not yet in this worktree's register.
- CAP-44.f (lite) has no closed ticket until W2-52 closes.
recommended_next_action: The orchestrator puts P-1 (the CAP-45.a record) and the K (2) confirmation to the owner along with the DEC-741 commit, then holds W2-49 until W2-51 closes.
